what: Second tap after a timeout files a second paid claim
note: server dedup is correct; the client defeats it by minting clientSubmissionId inside handleSubmit instead of at draft time. PRD:721-724 offline dedup contract unmet.

what: One Operations Head can approve then pay the same voucher
note: two-person control assumed from role names only. markPaid has reviewedBy on the row and never reads it.

what: Engineer cannot resubmit a clarification request; claim is stranded
note: SPINE E-16 is marked OK in static.md on route existence alone. No client calls the route: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION is terminal in the shipped app. Contradiction recorded, not averaged.

what: Reject reason is stored and returned but never shown to the engineer
Fraud check gets no ticket or plant, so it always warns

what: Ticket check only proves the ticket exists, not that it matches
note: no plant match, no expense-date-vs-visit-date match, no check the SE was assigned to that ticket. A claim citing any real ticket id passes.

what: Screen says the engineer is notified; the notifier only writes a log
note: settled by code, not a hypothesis: vouchers.module.ts:18 binds VOUCHER_NOTIFIER useClass LoggingVoucherNotifier unconditionally, no env switch and no second implementation in the module. Seam itself is legitimate per CLAUDE.md (FCM/WhatsApp external); the finding is the admin subtitle asserting a notification that never leaves the process.

what: No way to undo a voucher marked PAID by mistake
note: one-way door. May be deliberate (Finance owns reversal outside the app) — priced, flagged, never silently accepted. SPINE E-17 already calls it out.

what: Bulk export of every approved claim is not audited
note: static.md counts write-verb endpoints only, so this read does not appear there. It emits every SE name, zone and amount for a month with no record of who pulled it.

what: Half a Mark-PAID batch can commit and the rest fail
note: per-voucher loop, one tx each (static.md tx column = no for mark-paid). A mid-batch failure leaves a partially-paid batch under one batchRef and no reconciliation to find it.

what: No offline draft; a claim cannot be filed without signal
note: photo upload is synchronous before submit, so the form needs signal twice. DRAFT/SUBMITTED enum states exist but are dead. Owning issue #17 named unbuilt in the source comment. Fixing this is the natural home for VCH-01.

what: Spend limits are hardcoded and cannot be changed by the business
note: flag-not-block is correct per PRD. The gap is 'configured': changing a limit is a code deploy, and there is no history of what the limit was when a past voucher was approved.

what: One Operations Head can approve then pay the same voucher
note: WALKED 2026-09-02. One OH principal (ops.head@fsm.test, user 3333..) cleared BOTH gates at runtime: POST /vouchers/<uuid>/review -> 404 VOUCHER_NOT_FOUND (RoleGuard passed, service reached) and POST /vouchers/mark-paid -> 200 result OK. WM on the same review route -> 403 and ZM on mark-paid -> 403, so the 404/200 pair is guard-clearance, not a permissive server. Guard overlap is E4. The residual - one OH approving and then paying the SAME row - is UNTESTABLE here: no voucher can be created (see VCH-01 note). markPaid never reads voucher.reviewedBy (:312), so nothing downstream of the guard restores the two-person control. Strongest alternative (an outside guard or interceptor blocks OH from review) is now DEAD by measurement.

what: Resubmit route is live but no client calls it
note: WALKED 2026-09-02. FALSIFIES the C7 code, not the user-facing claim. SE POST /vouchers/<uuid>/resubmit -> 404 VOUCHER_NOT_FOUND: the guard passes and the service runs its findUnique, so the backend path is ALIVE. ZM on the same route -> 403, confirming Roles SERVICE_ENGINEER is the real gate. So this is no-UI (C4: wire a button plus an apiResubmitVoucher wrapper), NOT no-path-at-all (C7: build the route). Materially cheaper: domainLogic 1->0, lanes drop api. The SE still cannot resubmit in the shipped app, so sev stays S4. Residual: that a real NEEDS_CLARIFICATION row actually flips to ZONAL_MANAGER_REVIEW is UNTESTABLE without an SE fixture.

what: Second tap after a timeout files a second paid claim
note: UNTESTABLE 2026-09-02, ev held at E2. POST /vouchers as se.north -> 400 SE_NOT_FOUND. The auth fixture (auth-fixture-seed.ts:74) seeds a users row for se.north@fsm.test with user_id 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 but NO engineer_master row; create() requires one at vouchers.service.ts:162. FIXTURE THAT WOULD SETTLE IT: one engineer_master row with engineer_id = 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222, zone_id 1, coverage_type DEDICATED, daily_capacity 5. Then POST the same body twice with the SAME clientSubmissionId (expect duplicate true, one row) and once with a DIFFERENT id (expect a second row), and re-GET /me/vouchers. Separate defect found while probing: a clientSubmissionId that is not a UUID returns an unhandled 500, not 400 - the controller checks typeof string only (:63) while the column is db.Uuid (schema.prisma:1176). Real clients send Crypto.randomUUID, so this is S0 noise, folded here not filed.

what: Fraud check gets no ticket or plant, so it always warns
note: UNTESTABLE 2026-09-02, ev held at E2, same SE_NOT_FOUND blocker as VCH-01. Narrowed for free: the API side is NOT the gap - CreateBody at vouchers.controller.ts:36-39 accepts plantId, ticketId and vehicleId and toBigInt()s them, so the anchor is purely a mobile omission. Same fixture as VCH-01 settles it, then read GET /vouchers as ZM and look for warning NO_ACTIVITY_LINK on the row.

what: Bulk export of every approved claim is not audited
note: WALKED 2026-09-02. OH GET /vouchers/export?month=2026-09 -> 200 text/csv, header row measured: voucher_id,se_id,se_name,zone_id,plant_id,ticket_id,vehicle_id,status,submitted_at,voucher_total,category,amount,merchant_vendor_name,expense_datetime. Named SEs, their zone and their money, one call, no audit write in exportApproved(). NARROWED: the over-scope worry is FALSIFIED - ZM -> 403 and CSM -> 403, so only OH can pull it and no ZM can reach another zone's money data. The finding is unaudited, not over-permissioned. WIDENED: there is also no READER - /api/audit-trail exposes tickets only (audit-trail.controller.ts:20), so the audit rows vouchers DO write (create/review/resubmit/markPaid) are unreachable from any screen, against the 7-year financial retention the schema claims at schema.prisma:1166. Folded here rather than filed separately: it does not block this claim, it deepens it.

what: Half a Mark-PAID batch can commit and the rest fail
note: WALKED 2026-09-02. OH POST /vouchers/mark-paid with voucherIds [nonexistent uuid] and batchRef S3-WALK -> HTTP 200, result OK, paid [], skipped [{status NOT_FOUND}]. A batch in which EVERY id failed is reported as OK with HTTP 200; the failure lives only in a skipped[] array the caller must inspect. Combined with the per-voucher loop and one tx each (:321,:331), a Finance operator gets the same green result for a full success, a half-commit and a total miss. Reproduces the reconciliation half of this gap at E4; the mid-batch partial commit itself stays E2 (needs APPROVED rows, blocked by SE-FIXTURE).
